run_SpotSkillManager_pick: run SpotSkillManager to pick a specified object like a cup using mobile pick mode
run_SpotSkillManager_open_gripper: run SpotSkillManager to open the robot gripper after picking an object
run_SpotSkillManager_dock: run SpotSkillManager to navigate the robot to its dock and shut down
test_SpotSkillManager: test the SpotSkillManager class by picking objects and opening the gripper in a loop
review_map_user_input_to_boolean: review the map_user_input_to_boolean utility that converts Y/N user input to a boolean value
